text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит commits the entirety of
her
abilities, but ends up losing against
the more
vigorous Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Feeling pressured by Taishin's display,
Ticket tells
herself that she needs to
work harder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, she sets her sights on the
Takarazuka
Kinen, the race to conclude
the first half of the
Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
